# A2 — 'E: Unable to locate package shaderc' on the Ubuntu 24.04 runner

**Section**: A. CI & build pipeline
**Keywords**: apt-get, build, github-actions, glslc, install, libvulkan-dev, llama.cpp, locate, noble, package, pipeline, restructured, runner, shaderc, spirv-headers, ubuntu, unable, uses, vulkan

## Problem

'E: Unable to locate package shaderc' on the Ubuntu 24.04 runner

## Root cause

shaderc was restructured in noble; llama.cpp's own CI uses glslc + spirv-headers

## Solution

apt-get install -y glslc libvulkan-dev spirv-headers
